findings.description: The bucket has no ACL restricting access to private and is explicitly noted as public, with no public access block configuration, exposing its contents (including customer-master.xlsx) to unauthorized/unauthenticated access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so all objects stored in this bucket are persisted unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: The object customer-master.xlsx, which appears to contain sensitive customer data, is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, a bucket that is publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive data to unauthorized parties.
The bucket stores financial data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored operational data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, so data science datasets are stored without encryption at rest.
